subject: wrangler
detail: When unset, the strategy defaults to deferred with a 5-minute maximum delay; configure durable_objects.code_update_strategy to set it.

test.error: FAIL: wrangler deploy --help does not list --durable-objects-code-update-mode

source.quote: Use `--durable-objects-code-update-mode deferred 30s` to set a maximum delay, or configure `durable_objects.code_update_strategy` with `mode` and `max_delay`. When unset, the strategy defaults to deferred with a 5-minute maximum delay;
